original_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: polished story environment for an otome 2.5D/3D character content package. Vertical portrait 9:16 image. Premium cinematic realistic 3D rendering, beautiful restrained textures, physically coherent room geometry, crisp details, soft natural lighting. No people, silhouettes, body parts, human reflections, text, titles, captions, logos, watermark or bottom lettering. No identifiable country, real city, brand or street address. Single continuous full-frame location concept of an unnamed modern coastal city's quiet seafront route as a POSSIBLE future date location, not an event already happening. Human eye-level view from a small coastal overlook beside a gentle two-way paved coastal road curving along sea, safe simple guardrail and pedestrian path, low scrubby coastal greenery, calm muted blue sea and distant coastline. Soft clear morning/late afternoon light, tranquil inviting ordinary place, warm stone and weathered metal. Include a small simple bench only if composition benefits. No people, vehicles, motorcycles, racing, romantic decorations, luxury resort, country-specific road signs, address or recognizable landmark. Premium otome 3D environment quality. Natural plausible road and pedestrian separation.
